profile.title: Red to near-infrared photobiomodulation treatment of the visual system in visual system disease or injury
profile.problem: The technical problem is the need for effective treatment of visual system diseases or injuries, such as those affecting the retina, cornea, or optic nerve, using non-invasive photobiomodulation.
profile.core_invention: A method of treating visual system disease or injury by exposing a component of the visual system to light with wavelength 630-1000 nm and power intensity 10-90 mW/cm^2 for 1-3 minutes, leading to an increase in metabolically active neurons and restoration or protection of visual function.
independent_claims: A method of treating visual system disease or injury, comprising the steps of a) exposing a component of a patient's visual system to light treatment, wherein the light treatment is characterized by wavelength between 630-1000 nm and power intensity between 10-90 mW/cm^2 for a time of 1-3 minutes, and b) observing restoration or protection of visual function, wherein the number of metabolically active neurons has increased.
